scope: Generated AC1024 TABLESTYLE DXF CMC truecolor and color-book codec control
specification: Open Design Specification for .dwg files v5.4.1, §§20.4.101.3–20.4.101.4 (TABLESTYLE content and cell-style fields); DXF CMC group-code encoding is exercised as a generated codec control, not independently producer-qualified.

implementation.writer: The typed R24 TABLESTYLE writer validates the bounded CMC payload and emits the base group 62 value, optional 420 RGB integer, and optional 430 BOOK$ENTRY string. It bounds UTF-8 field lengths, rejects unsafe separators and inconsistent name flags, and preserves the generated name/book split.
implementation.parser: The TABLESTYLE parser tracks whether the optional CMC fields were present and reconstructs RGB, color name, book name, method, and flags for background, content, and border colors. Group 62 value 256 is accepted as the base selector for a following truecolor field.
implementation.limits: Only the generated bounded CMC profile is covered. Native CAD rendering, independent producer behavior, the full DXF color-book domain, and broader document graph closure are not established.

fields: title background: RGB 0xAABBCC, book Palette, entry Sky Blue
content color: RGB 0x123456, book Palette, entry Warm Gray
border color: RGB 0x654321, book Palette, entry Accent
assertions: writer emits group 62/420/430 for each color profile
fresh readback preserves typed RGB, entry, book, method, and flags
out-of-range RGB 0x1000000 is refused without replacing the destination
corrected write succeeds on the same adapter after refusal
generated_controls.fixture_policy: No DWG/DXF fixture files were added; generated outputs are temporary and removed by the test.

support_claim: This receipt records generated encoder/parser consistency and refusal/retry behavior only; it does not independently qualify native CAD semantics or expand DWG/DXF support claims.
